Subject: Post-signature MAP: execution sequencer & canary rehearsal plan (BrightBridge Labs)

Hi Kate,

Congrats again on finalizing the contract — excited to get BrightBridge into a staged production run. Attached is a first-pass implementation MAP that embeds the post-signature execution sequencer (kickoff -> canary -> migration -> training -> full roll). High level summary up top, then ownership and acceptance gates per phase.

Key dates (proposed):
- Week 0 (2025-06-30): Kickoff + environment provisioning (project kickoff, access matrix, shared runbooks)
- Week 2 (2025-07-14): Canary rehearsal (internal + BrightBridge devs, synthetic traffic)
- Week 3 (2025-07-21): Canary live with 5% traffic; 48-hr stability window
- Week 5 (2025-08-04): Data migration window (incremental sync, low-traffic hours)
- Week 6 (2025-08-11): Training & knowledge transfer (train-the-trainer + ops runbook handover)
- Week 7 (2025-08-18): Gradual ramp to 100% production traffic (staged ramps)

Acceptance criteria and rollback triggers are in the MAP (page 2). A few callouts:
- Canary size: start at 5% user traffic or 3 concurrent long-lived sessions (whichever is larger). Fail criteria: >2% error-rate delta or >30% latency P95 delta vs baseline.
- Data migration: incremental-first approach; final cutover only after acceptance gates pass for two consecutive days.
- Training: 2 train-the-trainer sessions + 3 recorded runthroughs; ops will have checklist and post-mortem template.

Attachments: MAP_v1_BrightBridge.xlsx (live doc) — I uploaded an editable copy to the shared Drive (link below).

Next steps I propose:
1) Confirm blackout windows (do you have any dates we must avoid for BrightBridge?)
2) Confirm canary weekend preference (Thu–Fri vs Sat–Sun)
3) I'll schedule a 30-min kickoff for Tuesday 2025-06-24 to confirm owners and share runbook links.

Assigning initial owners: Marcus (RD) overall exec; Vanessa (Enablement) training; Ben (SRE liaison) migration and canary ops.

Thanks — attaching MAP_v1 for review.

--
Marcus Lin

Marcus — thanks for the plan and the clear dates. Quick clarifications from our side:

- Blackout windows: please avoid 2025-07-04 through 2025-07-06 (we have a maintenance window and exec OOO).
- Canary timing: we prefer Thu–Fri rehearsal and Sat–Sun limited live canary if you recommend it — key is that engineering will be staffed for both rehearsal and live days.
- E2E test environment: we have a mirror staging cluster (staging-bb) but it is not full-scale. Can Redwood run the synthetic traffic profile you referenced against it ahead of canary?

Two asks:
1) Can you add explicit rollback runbook owners in the MAP?
2) Please confirm whether the migration window requires read-only mode for 30 minutes or a larger freeze period.

If you can answer the two asks I’ll confirm owners internally and sign off on the kickoff invite.

Thanks,

Kate — great questions. Short answers below and I’ve attached an operational checklist for the canary rehearsal.

1) Blackout windows: noted. We will avoid the 7/4–7/6 window. Revised plan moves rehearsal to week starting 7/14 and live canary to 7/21 as proposed.

2) Rollback owners: added explicit owners in the MAP (column: rollback_owner). Primary rollback owner: Ben Carter (SRE liaison). Secondary (customer contact): BrightBridge IT (itops@brightbridge.com). Rollback runbook is attached as the first tab in the MAP; highlights: kill routing, restore DNS weight, revert to last known-good model bundle, and DB failback procedure.

3) Migration freeze: The recommended approach is an incremental sync with a short final freeze. We expect a maximal read-only freeze of 15–30 minutes for final cutover (this is in the migration acceptance criteria). We have included a contingency for an extended freeze (2 hours) if checks fail — that would be an explicit escalation and requires signoff from BrightBridge IT and Redwood SRE.

4) Staging load tests: Redwood can generate the synthetic profile and run it against staging-bb. Ben, can you confirm that we have a runner and throttling policy for staged tests?

Attached: canary-rehearsal-checklist.pdf (detailed rehearsals steps + owner matrix). Also added the rollback_owner column in MAP_v1 on the Drive.

Proposed next step: I’ll update the MAP on Drive and send an invite for Tue 2025-06-24 11:00 PT for a 30-min kickoff to confirm owners and finalize the rehearsal date.

Thanks,
Marcus
